Gross margin is stable in the 74–76% band (no operating leverage upside, no compression downside). Net margin expansion of +9pp over 5y reflects scale + VMW software mix. §6CAPITAL ALLOCATION FLOW · where each FCF $1 goes
TTM FCF $22.5B → buyback / dividend / R&D / capex / M&A / debt paydown · this is the Buffett "where does the cash go" lens
Allocation grade · A: 38% buyback + 24% dividend + 18% debt paydown = 80% of FCF returned to capital or used to retire liabilities. Only 14% reinvested in R&D + capex (asset-light franchise — IP, not fabs). 6% retained as dry powder for next transformative M&A. Shareholder yield 2.60% well above S&P 500 median of ~1.8%. This is the Buffett alignment: management buys back shares when stock trades below fair value (CEO Hock Tan's 2018, 2020, 2022 buyback flows match those troughs).
§7INVESTMENT THESIS · BULL vs BEAR
where each case takes the stock · when it triggers · what evidence resolves it
▲ BULL · AI-accelerator + software flywheel $580+32%
  • Custom-silicon TAM expands to $90B by FY27. Hyperscaler ASIC pipeline (GOOG TPU, META MTIA, AAPL N-series, OPENAI Stargate) all run on AVGO physical-layer IP.
  • VMware perpetual → subscription conversion lifts software ARR from $9B → $14B by FY26. Gross margin 86% (vs 75% blended) drags consolidated GM up 200bps.
  • FCF growth holds 18–22% for 3+ years → P/FCF re-rates to 26× from current 24×.
  • Buyback acceleration as net debt < $50B (post-FY26): authorization size doubles to $20B annual cadence.
Trigger: FY26 Q1 guide raises FY rev to > $66B (probability 55%) · Hits: 12-18 months
▼ BEAR · custom-silicon multiple compression $345−22%
  • NVDA captures hyperscaler ASIC via Blackwell + Rubin pricing power → AVGO custom-silicon roadmap delayed 2 quarters.
  • VMware churn at renewal ≥ 15% as enterprises balk at 3× license-cost reset → software ARR misses $11B FY25 anchor.
  • FCF growth decelerates to single-digit post FY25 → P/FCF de-rates to 18× (5y trough).
  • Recession-cycle semis reset: enterprise/storage segments drop 15-20% YoY → consol revenue growth < 10%.
Trigger: any quarter showing software ARR < $11B run-rate (probability 18%) · Hits: 9-15 months
Probability-weighted fair value: 0.55 × $580 + 0.27 × $475 + 0.18 × $345 = $510 · +15.9% to spot. The bear-case is non-trivial (18%) but well-defined — software ARR is a countable, leading indicator, not a vague macro fear. Monitor: VMW renewal cohort #2 results (May–Jun '26) and Google FY27 TPU roadmap leaks.
